_note: Landmarks for art/scripts/26_landmarks.py. Game coordinates (x east, z south), metres. Monolith footprints from OpenStreetMap; heights, banners and planter slabs and the raised level from the photos and videos in 'Red Square/'.

obelisk._note: pyramid on a thin steel plate, on the flat aggregate top right at the sloped edge (photo); yaw lines it up with that edge

planters._note: [rotation deg, length, width, gap from the drain] per slab; centre placed from the webcam view and photos 4711/4736

levels._note: Raised levels. Each edge i (point i to i+1) is 'bank' (sloped granite + curb), 'stairs', or omitted (a plain edge against a building, the other level or the pillars). The hill is separate (hill).

list.name: kane_east
list._note: east of Kane's stairs: Broken Obelisk stands on it; the hill (below) rises onto edge 2

list.name: north
list._note: the big space in front of Odegaard joining Kane's open strip; its south edge runs behind the pillars (no stairs there); the way down on this side is the two flights by the pillars

hill._note: long gentle ramp up onto edge 2 of kane_east, right of the obelisk: cosine profile (eased top and bottom), max slope = atan(pi/2 * height / run) ~ 3.9 deg; paved with the plaza brick

odegaardStairs._note: two flights of 3 steps (17.5 cm) with a landing, between Odegaard's corner and the pillars (photos 4723, 4724)
